description: The accepted material carried by the domain.accepted transition of derive-system-requirements: the accepted requirements bundle, the accepted UC scenarios with their terminal branches, the accepted verifiable-statement set, and the accepted standalone evidence bindings. Derived from the frozen WP03 fixtures (accepted-id-sets.json + green/requirements-bundle.json) so the green path cross-validates against the frozen contracts.

requirements.statement: The system shall compute cart totals, take payment and emit an order confirmation for the checkout scenario.
The system shall process the scheduled batch idempotently and record an observable batch result.
Order records shall be retained for the compliance-pinned period.
Every emitted order confirmation shall be audit-logged inside the system boundary.
Operational telemetry shall be retained for the agreed window.

evidenceBindings.observableTerminalResult: Failed batch runs are recorded and audited
